findings.title: Emails without unsubscribe_url will raise MissingInterpolationArgument
findings.body: The updated `unsubscribe_link` translation now requires an `%{unsubscribe_url}` interpolation. In `MessageBuilder#html_part` (line 67) and `MessageBuilder#body` (line 90), `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` is called whenever `add_unsubscribe_link` is true. If the caller did not provide `unsubscribe_url` in opts, `template_args` lacks that key and Rails raises `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument`, causing the email to fail. Previously only `user_preferences_url` was required, which is always present. Existing mailers that set `add_unsubscribe_link: true` but do not pass `unsubscribe_url` will break. Provide a default or conditionally include the topic-specific line.

findings.title: unsubscribe action crashes when user has no TopicUser record
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` may return `nil` for users who have never visited the topic or have no explicit topic-user row (e.g., receiving notifications via category watching). The next line (107) calls `tu.notification_level`, raising `NoMethodError` on nil. The unsubscribe link is included in notification emails and may be clicked by such users. Use `TopicUser.get` or create/ensure a record before modifying.

findings.title: Notification level change bypasses TopicUser.change and only downgrades one step
findings.body: The action manually sets `tu.notification_level` and calls `tu.save!`. This skips `TopicUser.change`, which sets `notifications_changed_at`, `notifications_reason_id`, publishes a MessageBus event, and handles creation. As a result, the UI will not reflect the change and tracking metadata is missing. Additionally, the logic sets to regular if current level is above regular, otherwise muted. A user watching/tracking a topic will only be downgraded to regular, still receiving notifications for replies and mentions, not fully unsubscribing as the page claims. Consider using `TopicUser.change(current_user.id, topic_id, notification_level: TopicUser.notification_levels[:muted])` directly.

findings.title: Misspelled property name stopNotificiationsText
findings.body: The computed property is named `stopNotificiationsText` (extra 'i' in 'Notificiations'). It is referenced consistently in the template, so functionality is unaffected, but the spelling is incorrect and could cause confusion for future maintenance.

findings.title: Markdown links in text email unsubscribe footer are not rendered
findings.body: The `unsubscribe_link` translation now uses Markdown link syntax (`[text](%{unsubscribe_url})`). In the plain text email body generated by `MessageBuilder#body`, this string is inserted directly without Markdown processing, so recipients see raw Markdown like `[click here](https://...)` instead of a plain URL or formatted link. This degrades the text email experience. Consider using plain URLs for the text version or a separate text-specific translation.

findings.title: No test for missing unsubscribe_url or new controller action
findings.body: The spec was updated to pass `unsubscribe_url` but there is no test verifying that `MessageBuilder` handles the absence of `unsubscribe_url` gracefully (which it currently does not). Additionally, no tests were added for the new `TopicsController#unsubscribe` action, including the nil TopicUser case and the notification level transition. These gaps leave the high-severity bugs in this PR undetected.
